rdfs:label: subOrganizationOf
rdfs:comment: The parent Organization of which this Organization is a part — e.g. a subsidiary's parent company or a department's parent; inverse of hasSubOrganization. For OrganizationalUnits specifically, unitOf is the narrower form.
notes: Inverse of `urn:solid:hasSubOrganization`. Use on a unit to point at its parent — useful for traversal up an org chart. Typically declared once (a unit has one parent), but ORG allows multiple parents for matrix structures.

examples.title: Engineering team pointing at parent company

history.note: Comment generalised to any sub-organization (unitOf is the OrganizationalUnit-specific form); added unitOf to notToBeConfusedWith.
